SPLIT CANDIDATE (reviewer): the park's three campgrounds are one facility (facID=41) but sit at two places. Campgrounds 1+2 (engine loops 68 and 69, sites 1E-161E, 156 public electric sites; centroids 44.43455,-100.39115 and 44.43183,-100.38874; current pin) share one wooded area west of the river. Campground 3 (loop 70, sites 163E-205E, 41 public electric sites + cabins C1-C8; centroid 44.42357,-100.3882) is ~1.0 km south on the far side of the ~200 m-wide channel below the dam, on its own road (on imagery the only crossing is the SD-1806 bridge west of the campgrounds). It also runs a different season: GFP keeps Campground 3 open year-round while 1 and 2 close Nov. 15 - last Friday of March. Both would book at https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 (GFP 'Campground #3 Map'). The engine does not label loops by campground number: the 1/2/3 mapping is from the loop geography and GFP's map titles.

WATERFRONT LEAD (riverview, not an upgrade on its own): stored not waterfront. CG 1-2's nearest sites (102E 44.43065,-100.38475; 105E) are ~100 m from the water behind the loop road, a day-use lot and the swim beach - not waterfront. Campground 3's north row 201E-205E (205E 44.42613,-100.39112; 201E 44.42527,-100.39037) sits ~20-40 m from the channel bank (Missouri tailwater, ~200 m wide) behind a tree row and a riprap/gravel edge, so at most riverview from those five sites; the C1-C8 cabins, not RV sites, front the river. If the entry is split, Campground 3 could carry riverview; as one whole-park entry not waterfront stays.
